title: Memory Go Bye Bye
description:
Hello, my forgetful little playthings!
It’s time for yet another one of my Bye Bye files,this one deceptively more extreme than how it may appear.For those of you who have experience with any of the previous ones, this one should be self-explanatory. Like the others, it’s stand-alone, but is best enjoyed if you have some conditioning from any of the other Bye Bye files (Brain Go Bye Bye,Control Go Bye Bye,Inhibitions Go Bye Bye, andOrgasm Go Bye Bye).
If you haven’t yet listened toResist or Forget,now would be a good time, because it shares some triggers with this one.
A detailed summery will be at the bottom of this description, however be aware that if you are afraid of thunder, this file may be quite the trip. You can also, as always, read the script for full spoilers.
There are 4 different versions:
Rapid Non-Induction:this has a few drop triggers and deepening suggestions, but otherwise no true induction. If you can drop easily to the sound of my voice and a few snaps, this is probably the version you can go with:
Short Induction:this one uses a condensed version of the Bye Bye (Relaxed, Deep, Blank, Hypnotic Trance) induction.
Full Bye Bye Induction:this one uses the full version of the Bye Bye induction.
Kinky Induction:this is another full induction that I’ve paired with other Bye Bye files in the past (and which was originally introduced in the Kinky Workout file). It’s a more traditional, voice-focused style.
For the full, unabridged description, please follow the Reddit link below. For a lower quality audio stream, use Soundgasm. For videos, we’ve got…Pornhub.
Click on the three “dots” to the right of the player and choosedownloadfrom the menu.If there is no “download” option, try a different browser, like Chrome or Firefox.
author: Miss Lilith
